record.paper_title: Open problems in billiards and quantitative symplectic geometry
record.original_question: For Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms of complex projective space CP^n, does the quadratic lower bound for the growth of geometrically distinct primitive periodic orbits hold whenever there are infinitely many periodic orbits?

evidence.quote: Problem 2. Prove the conjecture for CPn

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(\mathbb{CP}^n, \omega_{\mathrm{FS}})$ denote complex projective space equipped with the Fubini–Study symplectic form. A Hamiltonian diffeomorphism $\varphi \in \mathrm{Ham}(\mathbb{CP}^n, \omega_{\mathrm{FS}})$ is the time-one map of a (time-dependent) Hamiltonian flow generated by some smooth $H \colon S^1 \times \mathbb{CP}^n \to \mathbb{R}$. A periodic orbit of $\varphi$ of period $k$ is a fixed point of $\varphi^k$; two periodic orbits are geometrically distinct if they are different as subsets of $\mathbb{CP}^n$, and a periodic orbit is called primitive of period $k$ if $k$ is the minimal positive integer for which the corresponding point is fixed by $\varphi^k$. For $T \geq 1$, let
$$N(\varphi, T) \; := \; \#\bigl\{\text{geometrically distinct primitive periodic orbits of } \varphi \text{ with period} \le T\bigr\}.$$

Prove or disprove: for every $\varphi \in \mathrm{Ham}(\mathbb{CP}^n, \omega_{\mathrm{FS}})$ which has infinitely many geometrically distinct periodic orbits, there exists a constant $c = c(\varphi) > 0$ such that
$$N(\varphi, T) \; \geq \; c\, T^2 \qquad \text{for all sufficiently large } T.$$
artifact.status_search_result: Searches on Ginzburg–Gürel and related work on the Conley conjecture and growth of periodic orbits on $\mathbb{CP}^n$ indicate this remains an open problem: while existence of infinitely many periodic orbits (Conley-type results) and various partial growth bounds are known under additional hypotheses (e.g. presence of a hyperbolic fixed point, or for pseudo-rotations), the quadratic lower bound conjecture for $\mathbb{CP}^n$ has not been established in general.

status_evidence.title: The Conley Conjecture and Beyond
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of the Conley conjecture and related growth/multiplicity questions for periodic orbits of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: The quadratic-growth question for periodic orbits on CP^n is discussed as an open direction beyond the basic Conley conjecture.

status_evidence.title: On Hyperbolic Points and Periodic Orbits of Symplectomorphisms (Batoréo)
status_evidence.snippet: For closed monotone manifolds including CP^n, a Hamiltonian diffeomorphism with a hyperbolic fixed point has infinitely many periodic orbits.
status_evidence.claim: Only conditional results (e.g. existence of a hyperbolic fixed point) are known; the general quadratic lower bound on CP^n remains unresolved.

status_evidence.title: Action and Index Spectra and Periodic Orbits in Hamiltonian Dynamics
status_evidence.snippet: Studies index/action spectra and gives partial results on the number of periodic orbits of Hamiltonian diffeomorphisms on rational symplectic manifolds.
status_evidence.claim: Provides framework underlying the conjectured quadratic growth, but does not prove it for CP^n.
